title: UE5 Module Dependency Graph Schema
description: Schema for module_graph.json - UE5 module dependencies and include mappings for KAIN codegen

_meta.description: Metadata about the module graph extraction

generator.description: Name of the script that generated this file

source.description: Path to the UE5 Engine/Source directory that was scanned

engine_scan.description: Path to the engine_scanned.json file used for cross-reference

total_types_mapped.description: Total number of types mapped to modules

total_headers_mapped.description: Total number of headers mapped to modules

total_api_symbols.description: Total number of API symbols mapped to modules

description.description: Human-readable description of this file's purpose

modules.description: Map of module name to module information

path.description: Relative path to the .Build.cs file from Engine/Source

public_deps.description: Public dependency module names (propagate to dependents)

private_include_path_modules.description: Modules whose headers can be included but not linked

public_include_path_modules.description: Modules whose public headers can be included

transitive_public_deps.description: Map of module name to its transitive public dependency closure

^[A-Za-z0-9_]+$.description: List of all transitive public dependencies for this module

type_to_module.description: Map of UE5 type name (class/struct/enum) to module name

^[A-Za-z0-9_]+$.description: Module name that defines this type

header_to_module.description: Map of header file path to module name

.*\\.h$.description: Module name that provides this header

api_to_module.description: Map of known API symbol to module name

^[A-Za-z0-9_]+$.description: Module name that provides this API symbol
